finalText:
**Found it: `pricing/engine.js` was rounding the percent discount to cents before converting currency.**

The percent coupon got rounded to 2 decimal places in USD, then that already-rounded number was converted to the order's currency and rounded again. Rounding twice instead of once nudges the final total off by a cent whenever the second rounding lands differently — which is why it only showed up sometimes, and only on GBP, CAD, and JPY orders with a percent coupon applied.

Fix: stopped rounding after the percent and flat discounts, so the math stays exact in USD and rounds only once, at the very end, in the target currency's own decimal places.

All 40 tests pass now.
